blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Whether or not the operating hours of the Manila North Cemetery during Undas—or the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day—will be extended will have to be evaluated by the local government of Manila. Mayor Francisco “Isko Moreno” Domagoso gave this view on Friday (October 30). As of now, Manila North Cemetery will only be open from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m. during annual holidays, with no extensions so far announced, despite a large influx of visitors expected.
